大.o: Depicts an adult man facing forward and standing erect. The meaning later shifted to "big".

How old is this university?

c.h: 忄 is a component form of 心.

性.o: Phonosemantic compound. 忄 represents the meaning and 生 represents the sound.

An understanding of the nature of things is needed to avoid making mistakes.

Tā zhǎng de bùcuò, dànshì xìnggé què bù zěnmedì.
She is quite good-looking, but her personality is not so flattering.

c.h: The traditional component 生 was removed for simplification.

产.o: Simplified form of 產. Phonosemantic compound. 生 represents the meaning and 彥 represents the sound. The traditional component 生 was removed for simplification.
w: to arise; to come into being; to come about

Wǒ duì zhè běn shū chǎnshēng le gòngmíng.

內.o: Depicts an entrance (入) to go inside a building (冂).

c.h: 灬 is a component form of 火.

how to take pictures of flowing liquids

to advance in rank; promotion; advancement

c.h: 纟 is a component form of 糸.
Depicts a continuous series of silk threads (丝) joined together.

继.o: Simplified form of 繼. Originally written as 㡭, which depicts a continuous series of silk threads (丝) joined together. The 纟 (silk) component was later added to clarify the meaning.

to inherit; to succeed to (the throne etc)

Wǒmen yīnggāi jìchéng zhèxiē chuántǒng.
We should carry on these traditions.

unimportant; not serious; it doesn't matter

Kùzi tài jǐn le.
These pants are too tight.

What have I got to be worried about?

to see a concert in Japan

Depicts grains of rice. Modern form looks like 釆.

奧.o: Depicts two hands (廾) hiding rice (米) in a corner or a container. Based on the original meaning "to store". The meaning later shifted to "obscure", "profound", and "mysterious".

c.h: 刂 is a component form of 刀.

剧.o: Phonosemantic compound. 刂 represents the meaning and 居 represents the sound. Simplified form of 劇.
w: script for play, opera, movie etc; screenplay
x: 这部电视剧太好看了！我已经开始四刷了！

This television drama is so good! I have already begun to watch through it for the fourth time!
这部电视剧太雷人了。
Zhè bù diànshìjù tài léirén le.
This TV series is too astonishing.

顧.o: Phonosemantic compound. 頁 represents the meaning and 雇 represents the sound.

Depicts a person with two hands outstretched.

执.o: Simplified form of 執. Pictograph of a person with hands (丮) bound by shackles (㚔). Based on the original meaning "seize". The meaning later shifted to "wield power", "carry out", and "hold".
w: to implement; to carry out; to execute
to enforce a law; law enforcement
hold in hand; keep; carry out
to be strongly attached to; to be dedicated

Nǐ gēn nèi ge rén fèi shénme huà a! Zhè rén kě gùzhi de hěn ne!
What do you speak in vain to that guy for (rhetorical)? They're quite stubborn!
事故的处理要严格按照国家法律规定的条例来执行。
Shìgù de chùlǐ yào yángé ànzhào guójiā fǎlǜ guīdìng de tiáolì lái zhíxíng.
Laws and regulations need to be strictly followed when responding to accidents.

瞧.o: Phonosemantic compound. 目 represents the meaning and 焦 represents the sound.

to look down on; to underestimate

Look at how silly he looks.

You better give me the money back, or I'll teach you a lesson!

Zhāng bóshì shì zhè chǎng jiǎngzuò de zhǔjiǎngrén.
Dr. Zhang is the presenter of this seminar.

货.o: Phonosemantic compound. 贝 represents the meaning and 化 represents the sound. Simplified form of 貨.
w: merchandise or commodities available immediately after sale

Nǐmen yǒu huīsè tào tóu máoyī de xiànhuò ma?
Have you any grey pullovers in stock?
这个商店有相当一批皮鞋现货。
Zhè ge shāngdiàn yǒu xiāngdāng yī pī píxié xiànhuò.
The store had quite an array of leather shoes in stock.

欧.o: Simplified form of 歐. Phonosemantic compound. 欠 represents the meaning and 區 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "vomit". The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
x: 欧洲有很多古老的城市。
Ōuzhōu yǒu hěn duō gǔlǎo de chéngshì.
Europe has many ancient cities.
她明年想去欧洲留学。
Tā míngnián xiǎng qù Ōuzhōu liúxué.
She wants to go to Europe to study next year.

旧.o: Simplified form of 舊. Derived from the cursive form of the sound component 臼.
x: 他重获旧职。
Tā chónghuò jiù zhí.
He got his former job back.
地毯旧了，但还能用。
Dìtǎn jiù le, dàn hái néng yòng.
The carpet is worn but still serviceable.

巧.o: Phonosemantic compound. 工 represents the meaning and 丂 represents the sound.
w: by chance; by coincidence; to happen to

What a coincidence!
上午我来的时候，你恰巧不在。
Shàngwǔ wǒ lái de shíhòu, nǐ qiàqiǎo bù zài.
You happened to be out when I came in the morning.

烧.o: Phonosemantic compound. 火 represents the meaning and 尧 represents the sound. Simplified form of 燒.

to have a high temperature (from illness)
to set fire to; to burn down; burning hot
to burn; to set on fire

The fire is burning cheerfully.

This transformer has burnt out. It should have been replaced a long time ago.

Different countries have different priorities.

I can only get to sleep by sleeping on my side.

糧.o: Phonosemantic compound. 米 represents the meaning and 量 represents the sound.

w: to die; to lose one's life
x: 你看起来很沮丧，怎么了？

You look depressed, what's up?

c.h: 阝 is a component form of 阜.

鄧.o: Phonosemantic compound. 阝 represents the meaning and 登 represents the sound.

to spill; to overflow (of water, crowds)

lit. look into one's heart, no shame (idiom); with a clear conscience

poor monk (humble term used by monk of himself)
lit. many monks and not much gruel (idiom)

to take a wrong step in life (idiom)
to diverge from the main road, also figuratively

碧.o: A stone 石 like amber 珀; 珀 also provides the pronunciation
w: gold and jade in glorious splendor (idiom)
blood shed in a just cause
x: 湖水碧绿，非常美丽。
Húshuǐ bìlǜ, fēicháng měilì.
The lake water is emerald green and very beautiful.
今天的天空一片碧蓝。
Jīntiān de tiānkōng yī piàn bìlán.
The sky today is a clear, deep blue.

w: tunnel, underground passageway, path to a tomb
x: 隧道开车灯。

Turn on headlights before entering tunnel.
火车从隧道里出来。

w: to cheer on (originally esp. as paid stooge)
to flatter; to laud sb's accomplishments
to win a championship; to come out top
lit. all the stars cup themselves around the moon (idiom, from…

to praise one another; mutual praise
to hold a vase in both hands

昧.o: Phonosemantic compound. 日 represents the meaning and 未 represents the sound.
w: bold; presumptuous; to take the liberty of

to pick up money and not hide it (idiom); to return property to…

c.h: 钅 is a component form of 金.

unit of measure equivalent to thirty catties

斧.o: Phonosemantic compound. 斤 represents the meaning and 父 represents the sound.
w: supernaturally fine craft (idiom); the work of the Gods
x: 这把斧子很重，你小心一点儿。
Zhè bǎ fǔzi hěn zhòng, nǐ xiǎoxīn yīdiǎnr.
This axe is heavy, so be careful.

c.h: 讠 is a component form of 言.

诧.o: Phonosemantic compound. 讠 represents the meaning and 宅 represents the sound. Simplified form of 詫.

to brag; exaggerated; to wonder at

Lǎogōng de xīn xiǎngfǎ, ràng wǒ yǒuxiē chàyì.
My husband's new idea surprised me a little bit.

咧.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 列 represents the sound.
w: to grimace (in pain); to show one's teeth
to swear while talking; to be foul-mouthed
to cry; to whimper; to talk drivel
to grimace (in pain); to show one's teeth
x: 你共我会记咧！
Lí kā góa ē kì leh!
Remember this!

喧.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 宣 represents the sound. Simplified form of 諠.
w: hubbub; clamor; to make a racket
lit. the voice of the guest overwhelms that of the host (idiom)
to make a tumult; hubbub; uproar
x: 禁止大声喧哗。
Jìnzhǐ dàshēng xuānhuá.
Please don't make noise.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

拧.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 宁 represents the sound. Simplified form of 擰.
w: to unscrew; to twist off (a lid)
x: 这水龙头好拧。
Zhè shuǐlóngtóu hǎo nǐng.
This tap turns easily.

朧.o: Phonosemantic compound. 月 represents the meaning and 龍 represents the sound.

胧.o: Phonosemantic compound. 月 represents the meaning and 龙 represents the sound. Simplified form of 朧.
w: Misty Poetry, a post-Cultural Revolution poetry movement
